blocks.text: Computing ka sab se bara positive (achha) asar yeh hai ke maloomat ka access (accessibility, yaani maloomat tak pohanch) barh gaya hai. Internet ki wajah se log taqreeban har topic par bohat si maloomat tak pohanch sakte hain, aur taleem aur ilm ke raste ki rukawatein toot gayi hain.
Misal: Coursera aur edX jaise online educational platforms remote (bohat door ke) ilaqon ke students ko duniya bhar ki mashhoor (prestigious) universities ke courses karne ka mauqa dete hain.

Is ke ilawa computing ne communication (baat cheet aur rabta) ko behtar banaya hai: ab log duniya bhar mein aasani aur tezi se jur sakte hain. Facebook aur X (Twitter) jaise social media platforms ne na sirf personal connections (zaati rishte) aasan kiye balke social movements (logon ki milkar chalai hui muhim), jaise #MeToo movement, ko duniya bhar mein phailne (global traction) mein madad di. Pakistan mein 2014 ke Peshawar school attack ke bare mein awareness (aagahi, yaani logon ko batana) phailane, madad jama karne aur solidarity (dukh mein saath khare hona) dikhane mein social media ne bara role ada kiya.

Computing ne nayi industries aur naukriyon ke mauqe paida kar ke economic growth (mulk ki kamai aur karobar ka barhna) bhi barhai hai. Daraz jaise e-commerce (online cheezein khareedna aur bechna) platforms ne business ke purane tareeqe (business models) badal diye hain, aur Pakistan ke chhote karobar ab poore mulk balke doosre mulkon ke customers tak bhi pohanch sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: MCQ 8: Society (muashre) par computing systems ka positive asar kaunsa hai? Computing ne society mein communication par kya asar dala? (Short question 6)
blocks.explanation: MCQ 8: (b) Maloomat tak behtar access (Improved accessibility to information). Communication: ab log duniya bhar mein aasani aur tezi se jur sakte hain. Facebook aur X (Twitter) jaise social media ne zaati rishte aasan kiye aur #MeToo jaisi social movements ko duniya bhar mein phailaya; Pakistan mein 2014 ke Peshawar school attack ke baad social media ne awareness, madad aur solidarity mein bara role ada kiya. Saath hi (7.5.2) social media ghalat maloomat bhi tezi se phailata hai.

items: Positive asar: maloomat ka access (Coursera, edX), behtar communication (Facebook, X, #MeToo, Peshawar school attack 2014), economic growth (Daraz).
